description: Drift class 4: GHOST RELEASE (changelog-only). v0.9.9 left a changelog in releases/ but has NO def in either location and is absent from history.recentReleases (the real v0.7.4 case). load_tiki_releases sees nothing; the doctor's changelog-stem widening (#301) reports it in recentReleasesMissingJson (warn, no Fix action); migrate-stale-artifacts reconstructs the archived def with the issue list parsed from the changelog's /issues/N links.
